description: Angular component for managing relation filters in the Thingsboard UI, including form controls, data binding, and change handling.

classes.name: RelationFiltersComponent
classes.description: Angular component for relation filters with form controls, change detection, and input handling.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and subscribes to value changes.

methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions on component destruction.
